title: Chinese Artificial Sun Sets New Record
supports: EAST maintained steady-state high-confinement plasma for 1,066 seconds on 2025-01-20
EAST is an experimental research platform

title: What is a tokamak?
supports: Tokamak uses strong magnetic fields to confine hot plasma
ITER is experimental and will not produce electricity
plasma energy is ultimately absorbed as heat in vessel systems

title: Divertor
supports: ITER target design heat flux is 10 MW/m2 steady and 20 MW/m2 slow transient

title: Blanket
supports: Blanket protects the vessel and magnets from heat and high-energy fusion neutrons
neutron kinetic energy becomes heat collected by coolant

title: Why does the plasma not melt the wall?
publisher: Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics
supports: Very hot fusion plasma is extremely dilute
core temperature and wall temperature are not the same physical quantity
